2438-7084-8338.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

907-2645-3430-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
907-2645-3430-4644.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Selesnya Sanctuary
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4289-4770-5301-7296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

277-1021-5414-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat.

147-719-6974.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Ashling's Command
147-719-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Ashling's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-719-6974.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

687-4613-5231-8130-8132.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three additional counters of any kind on Tayam and/or additional creatures you control.
687-4613-5231-8130-8132.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Easterling Vanguard, adding mana.
When Easterling Vanguard dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate [[Tayam]] by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, milling three cards and returning Easterling Vanguard from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability again, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter and a -0/-1 counter from the creature token and a vigilance counter from Easterling Vanguard.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Easterling Vanguard and the creature token, adding mana.
When Easterling Vanguard dies, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three cards and returning Easterling Vanguard from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.
687-4613-5231-8130-8132.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4976-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4976-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

372-1090-2072.manaNeeded: {6}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-2072.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

1874-3375-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1874-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

891-5147-7424.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5153-7150-7309.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
5153-7150-7309.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Don & Leo's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Don & Leo's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

2440-5295-7082-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka's first ability and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, attaching Trusty Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

903-2199-6124.notablePrerequisites: Karplusan Minotaur and Herald of Eternal Dawn have indestructible, protection from red or protection from creatures.
903-2199-6124.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Resolve a Frenetic Efreet ability, causing you to flip a coin.
Karplusan Minotaur triggers. If you won the flip, it deals 1 damage to any target you choose. If you lost the flip, it deals 1 damage to a target of an opponent's choosing. You cannot lose the game due to this damage due to Herald of Eternal Dawn, and Karplusan Minotaur and Herald of Eternal Dawn cannot be destroyed due to its indestructibility or protection.
Repeat from step 2.

3968-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3968-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Grave Titan as attackers.
Grave Titan triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

224-774-3772-4300.description:
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting up to two land cards from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land(s) enter, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers that many times, untapping Omen Hawker.
Repeat.

582-1409-5921.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve both Brazen Freebooter triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

5657-5664-7116.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}. Ulalek and Writhing Chrysalis' first ability trigger.
Holding priority, cast Eldritch Immunity by paying {C}. 
Ulalek triggers, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Resolve the copy of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-5705.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker triggers, creating an Eldrazi Spawn token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Manifold Key enters.
Repeat.

2364-4300-6871.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

427-486-1978.notablePrerequisites: You've drawn three or more cards this turn.
427-486-1978.description:
Cause Kydele to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kydele.
Repeat from step 2.

2556-5626-5733.manaNeeded: {5}{U} the first turn, with {7}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2556-5626-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
You have at least {E}.
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2556-5626-5733.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 2 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Mnemonic Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}, sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2316-4365-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4365-4871.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

997-1762-4871-5173-5626.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Wilhelt's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Wilhelt trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing the Zombie token, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2366-2907-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers, creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens or token copies of Scute Swarm.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2178-4410-5367.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4410-5367.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1636-2665-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2665-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying {4}{G}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Progenitor Mimic.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Progenitor Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Progenitor Mimic to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

175-3013-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-3013-3525.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

413-678-2459.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

751-914-2499.notablePrerequisites: Panharmonicon on the battlefield.Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
751-914-2499.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{R}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2106-3944-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Fighter Class is at least level two.
You control an Equipment with an Equip ability that costs {2} or less.
2106-3944-4763.description:
Activate any Equipment you control's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Blood Pet.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Koll triggers, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

717-779-2842-4279-4680.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
717-779-2842-4279-4680.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's second ability by paying {B}{B} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Bone Miser's second ability triggers, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel.
The Hollow Sentinel dies, triggering Blood Artist, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1029-1089-1742-4410.notablePrerequisites:
Hermetic Study and Curiosity attached to Tolarian Kraken.
Tolarian Kraken does not have summoning sickness.
1029-1089-1742-4410.description:
Activate Tolarian Kraken by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Resolve the Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap it.
Repeat.

880-2757-4862.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3348-4468.description:
At the beginning of your draw step, Island Sanctuary causes you to skip your card draw, and prevent creatures without flying and/or islandwalk from attacking you.
Because Mystic Decree causes all creatures to lose flying, only creatures with islandwalk can attack you.
